hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'cargo +(nextest +run|test)\b[^|;&]*(-p|--package)[ =]' && { echo 'BLOCKED: do not run tests per-crate. Run the whole suite: cargo nextest run. Per-crate runs miss the shared build cache and are SLOWER, not faster. See AGENTS.md.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'git +(checkout|commit|stage)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: do not run destructive git operations. Let the human do that.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
